responsibility: Implements Darwin-native GCC driver-side option rewriting and deployment-target selection. It validates and canonicalizes -mmacosx-version-min values, can infer a default deployment target from the running kernel or environment, interprets Darwin-specific options such as -arch, -framework, -filelist, and SDKROOT/sysroot handling, translates architecture names into the appropriate -m32/-m64 choices, and appends cleaned deployment-target options for the compiler and assembler. Its scope is driver command-line policy before cc1/assembler execution, not code generation.
